title: Work-tape cell update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $s$ be a snapshot of $M$, let $\tau$ be one of its work tapes, let $h_m$ indicate whether its head is at the cell, and let $c$ be the cell’s optional Boolean content. If $s$ is halted or $h_m$ is false, the updated content is $c$. Otherwise it is the value written by the transition on tape $\tau$, if a value is specified, and is $c$ if no value is specified.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
